content.text:
✅ **APIs.guru loaded successfully!** 

You now have access to the following tools for exploring the world's largest repository of OpenAPI definitions:

| Tool | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `get-providers` | List all API providers (659+ companies) |
| `get-provider` | List all APIs from a specific provider |
| `get-svcs` | List all services for a provider (like googleapis.com) |
| `get` | Get details of a specific API version |
| `get-svc` | Get details of an API with a service name |
| `lst-ap-is` | List ALL APIs in the directory |
| `get-metrics` | Get stunning stats for the whole directory |
